import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int K = 31;
    static final int MOD = (int)1e9 + 7;
    static int k = 0;

    static class Matr {
        int[][] a = new int[K + 1][K + 1];

        Matr() {
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                    a[i][j] = 0;
                }
                a[i][i] = 1;
            }
        }
    }

    static Matr multiply(Matr a, Matr b) {
        Matr c = new Matr();
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= k; j++) {
                c.a[i][j] = 0;
                for (int z = 0; z <= k; z++) {
                    c.a[i][j] = (int)((c.a[i][j] + 1L * a.a[i][z] * b.a[z][j]) % MOD);
                }
            }
        }
        return c;
    }

    static class MainClass {
        static Matr[] M = new Matr[K];
        static Matr[] pref = new Matr[K];
        static Matr[] suff = new Matr[K];

        static Matr get(int num) {
            Matr res = new Matr();
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                res.a[num][i] = 1;
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        List<Integer> v = new ArrayList<>();
        while (n > 0) {
            v.add((int)(n % k));
            n /= k;
        }

        Matr res = new Matr();
        int shift = 0;
        for (int val : v) {
            shift += val;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            MainClass.M[i] = new Matr();
            MainClass.pref[i] = new Matr();
            MainClass.suff[i] = new Matr();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < v.size(); i++) {
            shift -= v.get(i);
            for (int j = v.get(i) - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                if (i == 0) {
                    res = get((shift + j) % k) * res;
                } else {
                    res = MainClass.M[(shift + j) % k] * res;
                }
            }
            if (i == 0) {
                for (int i2 = 0; i2 < k; i2++) {
                    MainClass.M[i2] = new Matr();
                    for (int j = k - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                        MainClass.M[i2] = multiply(get((i2 + j) % k), MainClass.M[i2]);
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for (int i2 = 0; i2 < k; i2++) {
                    MainClass.M[i2] = new Matr();
                    if (i2 > 0) {
                        MainClass.M[i2] = multiply(MainClass.pref[i2 - 1], MainClass.M[i2]);
                    }
                    MainClass.M[i2] = multiply(MainClass.suff[i2], MainClass.M[i2]);
                }
            }
            // Update pref
            for (int i2 = 0; i2 < k; i2++) {
                if (i2 > 0) {
                    MainClass.pref[i2] = multiply(MainClass.pref[i2 - 1], MainClass.M[i2]);
                } else {
                    MainClass.pref[i2] = new Matr();
                    MainClass.pref[i2] = multiply(MainClass.pref[i2], MainClass.M[i2]);
                }
            }
            // Update suff
            for (int i2 = k - 1; i2 >= 0; i2--) {
                if (i2 + 1 < k) {
                    MainClass.suff[i2] = multiply(MainClass.M[i2], MainClass.suff[i2 + 1]);
                } else {
                    MainClass.suff[i2] = new Matr();
                    MainClass.suff[i2] = multiply(MainClass.M[i2], MainClass.suff[i2]);
                }
            }
        }

        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            ans = (ans + res.a[i][k]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
